SELECT a.area_code
FROM AREA_CODE_STATE AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM VOTES v
    JOIN CONTESTANTS c ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
    WHERE v.state = a.state
      AND c.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM VOTES v
    JOIN CONTESTANTS c ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
    WHERE v.state = a.state
      AND c.contestant_name = 'Kelly Clauss'
)
